definition.text: An artificer in stone. The Tyrians seem to have been specially skilled in architecture (1 Kings 5:17, 18; 2 Sam. 5:11). This art the Hebrews no doubt learned in Egypt (Ex. 1:11, 14), where ruins of temples and palaces fill the traveller with wonder at the present day.

lemmas.kjv: close up, fence up, hedge, inclose

lemmas.gloss: Chiram or Chirom, the name of two Tyrians
